name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: An initiative by the government of India in which all farmers will get up to ₹6,000 per year as minimum income support.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: A national public health insurance fund of the Government of India that aims to provide free access to health insurance coverage for low income earners.

name: PM Awas Yojana
description: An initiative to provide affordable housing for the urban and rural poor.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: A government of India backed saving scheme targeted at the parents of girl children.

name: Stand-Up India
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch.

name: Mudra Loan Scheme
description: Provides loans up to ₹10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.

name: PM Vishwakarma
description: Supports traditional artisans and craftspeople of rural and urban India.

name: E-Shram
description: A national database of unorganized workers for providing social security benefits.

name: National Scholarship Portal
description: One-stop solution through which various services starting from student application, application receipt, processing, sanction and disbursal of various scholarships to Students are enabled.

name: PMEGP
description: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) is a credit-linked subsidy scheme aimed at generating self-employment opportunities.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: A pension scheme for citizens of India focused on the unorganized sector workers.
